note: Pipeline settings that are the same for every style: models, trimming, output format and the verification tolerances. Everything about how a style looks and sounds lives in styles/<style>.json.

transcribe.note: faster-whisper. Only the text and language are used; word timings come from forced alignment.

align.note: wav2vec2 CTC forced alignment of the transcript. One model frame is 20 ms; the alignment is repeated with the audio shifted by 1/phases of a frame and averaged, so timings do not depend on where the clip starts. Audio longer than chunk_s is run through the model in overlapping windows.

trim.note: The clip starts on the first frame at most lead_s before the first word and ends on the first frame at least tail_s after the last word ends (or at the end of the recording).

output.note: Sources taller than wide become 1080x1920, others 1920x1080 (centre-cropped if the aspect differs). bt709 SDR in, bt709 out.

verify.note: caption_lead_frames: each caption's first frame (detected in the final frames, compared at 1/detect_scale size against the clean clip with each caption within detect_neighbours frames) comes 0-2 frames before its first word in the re-aligned final audio, +- align_tolerance_s (one CTC frame). shutter_*: biggest wave within shutter_tolerance_ms of the caption frame (cross-correlation over +-shutter_window_s); the shutter's level in the final relative to the plan within shutter_level_range. onset_*: a sound starts where the effects' level (RMS over onset_rms_s, every onset_hop_s) rises onset_rise_db above its level onset_before_s earlier, above onset_floor_db re its loudest moment; every onset must lie within allowed_onset_s of a caption frame (the shutter's clicks run from about -55 to +30 ms), and the effects part of the final must match the effects track (correlation >= effects_min_correlation).
